text.en: 1. These Rules are the Extradition (Application for Warrant) Rules 2022 and come into operation on 1 July 2022.

2. An application to a Magistrate mentioned in section 12(1)(a)(ii) of the Act for the issue of a warrant for the apprehension of a fugitive who is, or is suspected of being, in or on his or her way to Singapore must be made in accordance with the Form set out in the Schedule.
3. The Extradition (Application for Warrant) Rules (R 1) are revoked.

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 2
Extradition Act 1968
Application for Warrant
To , a District Judge [or Magistrate] of Singapore.
I, , of , inform you that (referred to in this Application as the fugitive) is accused (or has been convicted) of the offence of alleged to have been committed (or committed) in (or within the jurisdiction of) and that the fugitive is (or is suspected of being) in (or on his or her way to) Singapore, and I apply for the issue of a warrant for the apprehension of the fugitive.
Dated 20 .
......................................................
Applicant
